name: Longview Mahj Club
evidence: Join Longview's home for American Mahjong — learn the game, join our league, rent equipment, and find your people, one tile at a time.

name: North Iowa Mahjong Club
evidence: All are welcome to join our fun crew for Mall-jong on Thursdays from 4-6. Bring your 2026 NMJL card and a game set if you have one. We are inside Southbridge Mall - kitty corner from Sports Page, next to the Nail Salon.
